findings.subject: WP-6f source is merged while current status still says implementation pending

locations.literal: **WP-6f: Every-photo publication privacy screen — specification approved; implementation pending**

Branch: `wp-6f-photo-privacy-screening`. Justin's chosen policy is server-side open-detector screening of every photo, with individual flagged photos withheld for private human CLI review and no automatic blur. Start with face and scene-text screening. Until WP-6f is deployed and Justin approves calibration evidence, releases contain structured data only under the SPEC §11 photo-publication gate; passing existing QA or individual review cannot bypass it. After that gate, eligible observation data and other cleared photos proceed normally. **The specification approval and merge prerequisite was satisfied in #38.** Implementation remains pending; unresolved weight licenses, uncalibrated category coverage and separate production authorization remain gates. See SPEC §15.4 and [the detector comparison](PHOTO_PRIVACY_SCREENING.md).
Acceptance criteria for the later implementation PR:

**WP-6f implementation details (v8 proposal, SPEC §15.5–15.9):** `docs/spec-v8` → `wp-6fa-private-photo-privacy` → `wp-6fb-photo-privacy-worker` → `wp-6fc-photo-export-enforcement`, separate independently reviewed PRs with green CI. Preparation may proceed after the prerequisite specification commit; no implementation merge before its specification/predecessor. Owner-authorized code merges supply no production migration, dispatch, model approval, operator credential or photo-publication permission.
### 15.4 WP-6f: every-photo privacy screening, pending implementation approval

**Implementation gate:** the specification merge prerequisite is satisfied by #38. The later implementation PR needs migrations/RLS and export tests, private review authorization tests, reproducible detector-license/digest evidence, and calibration evidence before deployment; production commands still require a separate exact-target "go". This proposal neither starts screening nor claims current photos are screened.
### 15.5 WP-6f private state, policy and authority (v8 architecture proposal)

findings.recommendation: Mark 6fA/B/C source merged and link the exact PRs; retain detector artifact/license selection, calibration, personal operator provisioning, production deployment and photo-publication/capture gates. Requirements remain requirements; do not check mixed external acceptance boxes.

findings.subject: Merged v10 and LIB-5A/5B still described as draft or awaiting prerequisites

locations.literal: **v10 amendment status:** proposed clarification of LIB-5B local accounting, reserved fences, daily admission and the single-root simulation boundary in §16.12. This is specification work under Justin's keep-building authority; independent source review, green CI and this amendment's merge precede LIB-5B code. LIB-5A remains governed by the approved v9 pure contract. No real-source grant, credential, cleanup-authentication or retention policy is selected.

**Status:** the v5–v9 library/photo foundation, LIB-1 through LIB-4C and WP-6fA/B/C source are merged, including the owner-authorized ordered #51–#56 merges after independent review and green exact-head CI. LIB-5A implementation is separately reviewed; LIB-5B code awaits both merged LIB-5A and this reviewed clarification. Runtime photo code is built and reviewed; model calibration and production deployment remain separate gates. No code or specification merge authorizes production migration, deployment, publication, worker dispatch, peer enrollment or capture opening.

**v10 amendment status:** specification-only draft for the four LIB-5B local accounting/fence/admission/root clarifications. Independent source review, green CI and amendment merge precede LIB-5B code; approved v9 LIB-5A contract work remains independent.

**Owner approval:** Justin approved ordered #51–#56 source merges after green CI on 2026-10-13; those source/specification merges are complete. LIB-5A pure contracts may proceed under approved v9. LIB-5B synthetic code follows both merged LIB-5A and the reviewed/green/merged v10 clarification. Real-sharing source/retention/peer/credential choices remain unresolved; no federation rollout or production authority is granted.

**Governing document:** reviewed `docs/SPEC.md` on `main` (v5 foundation, v6/v7 private intake, v8 photo privacy and v9 bounded local exchange architecture; v10 proposes only local simulator clarification in §16.12). Existing launch gates are preserved; the draft is not an implementation or merge result. If this document and the spec conflict, the spec wins; flag the conflict instead of guessing. The v2.2 work plan, with the full WP-0 to WP-6 acceptance criteria, is archived in `docs/archive/v2.2/`.

**Approved local LIB-5 sequence (v9, with proposed v10 §16.12 clarification):** merged `docs/spec-v9` → `wp-lib-5a-exchange-contract`; `wp-lib-5b-private-exchange-ledger` follows both merged LIB-5A and reviewed/green/merged `docs/spec-v10`. Justin approved the local v9 architecture on 2026-10-13. v10 resolves only the four local simulator ambiguities; it changes neither LIB-5A's approved contract nor the unresolved real-sharing policies and transport in LIB-5C. Each package is a separate PR with independent adversarial review and green CI. `wp-lib-5c-scoped-peer-transport` remains blocked until the new source-sharing/privacy, peer-admission, credential/cleanup and same-material policy decisions are resolved. Preparing synthetic local code never permits real exchange, peer enrollment, production migration, deployment, public release or field training. Existing public readers remain anonymous/read-only and no service-role key or contributor session reaches an agent interface.

Branch: `wp-lib-5b-private-exchange-ledger`. Depends on merged LIB-5A and independently reviewed/green/merged v10 §16.12. Implement one deterministic synthetic-only draft/outbox/receiver simulator per operator-designated private root with fake authority and transport; do not add a real sender, downloader, peer listener, automatic contributor-directory scan or field-data export. A locally stored record's verified-state declarations and LIB-5A supplied-fact helpers cannot be treated as source authority. No implementation or test result is claimed by this specification draft.

findings.recommendation: Mark v10 clarification merged (#60), strict 5A source merged (#58) and synthetic-only 5B source merged (#64). Keep real authority/transport LIB-5C, licensed reference data, physical-pair verification, scientific evaluation, spectral privacy, capture and deployment held.
